verdict.rationale: GitCafe's own docs say users can browse files in the product (docs-2) and can read commit history, inspect single commits, and see who last changed each line of a file (docs-30). Most repository pages are also rendered as web pages, with Markdown versions available (docs-25). missing for 10: explicit confirmation that history and blame views live in the web UI rather than only in the CLI or API, detailed documentation of the blame view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
